question: Is high stress error mainly a shared fitting problem, or a training-to-new-geometry transfer problem?
evidence_required_before_selection: Both fixed4800 complete TRAIN120 physical U/S/hot metrics
Both same60 development physical U/S/hot metrics with the full120 prediction barrier
Training curves and complete costs, per-load20 and paired-CAD20 differences
Original physical units and no subset mean, no sealed final readout

branch_fitting_remains_high.trigger: TRAIN stress above 15% for the better complete matched arm; this is a diagnostic priority, not a success criterion or early stopping rule
branch_fitting_remains_high.next_question: Can the existing representation/operator fit a fixed known training case, and what part of the field is lost by grid representation?
branch_fitting_remains_high.design_direction: Use an existing TRAIN120 case selected from the fixed-endpoint TRAIN errors, keeping the20 development CADs outside this new fitting task. One independently trained selected solver control versus its saved shared prediction at exactly that case, same scaler/native nodes and recorded exposure. Compare signed-S hotspots and displacement jointly. A separate geometric/grid representation diagnostic uses this already-known TRAIN truth, not sealed fields.
branch_fitting_remains_high.scope_limit: No automated learning-rate/mode/hash-layer sweep; source/budget/exposure choices locked before new numerical work. Do not explain all high DEV error as generalization when TRAIN fitting itself is poor.

branch_training_low_transfer_high.trigger: TRAIN stress at or below15%, but same60 development stress above30% for the better complete matched arm
branch_training_low_transfer_high.next_question: Does available CAD diversity improve cross-geometry prediction at fixed model and compute, or does the geometry/BC interface miss transferable structure?
branch_training_low_transfer_high.design_direction: Use only the actual complete official CAD three-piece sources available now and a separately frozen CAD split/scaler. Compare data coverage with fixed solver/compute; input availability is not a solver-accuracy result. A prospective graph/whole-mesh interface is considered only if its macro information contribution is specified and source available, with no repeated failed large download.

branch_both_materially_improve.trigger: Complete matched solver TRAIN and DEV stress low enough that fitting/transfer diagnostics no longer dominate
branch_both_materially_improve.next_question: Can it preserve accuracy, numerical consistency and physical boundary response at arbitrary positions and new load combinations?
branch_both_materially_improve.design_direction: Independent held-out CAD validation and correctly defined load/BC combinations, full-node U/signed-S plus functional gradients/physical units. Off-node FEM accuracy needs independent source truth or an explicitly labeled proxy; numerical AD/FD consistency alone is insufficient.

solver_choice: Use complete matched primary score and CAD/load consistency/cost to prioritize solver family; no presumption of Hash/FNO/Transolver and no claim of architecture upper bound.
